# luwu stance registry

The stances below are first-principles objectives, not checklists. They are deliberately opposed: each demands something another one pays for. A review that finds no conflict must still say which axes it checked and why the design already satisfies them; silence is not evidence.

The canonical topology is the review graph. The stance prose stays in the linked skills. This registry is a generated view; edit the graph, then regenerate.

## Migration note

- Source: Luwu 0cdc498
- Old stance count: 5
- New stance count: 9
- authority-vs-completion and equivalence-vs-noise were deferred by a five-stance working range. The owner documents already record sacrifices on both axes, so they are forged here. Nine is the result, not a quota.

## Stances

| Stance                                                                                 | Axis                                          | Objective                                                                                                                                         | Accepts                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [`luwu-proof-at-write-stance`](../luwu-proof-at-write-stance/SKILL.md)                 | proof-vs-cost                                 | Nothing is written without a fresh read of the exact bytes and identities that authorize it.                                                      | `luwu-bounded-cost-stance` pays: whole-profile proof costs latency and throughput                                                                                                                             |
| [`luwu-bounded-cost-stance`](../luwu-bounded-cost-stance/SKILL.md)                     | proof-vs-cost                                 | A profile-scale run stays inside measured budgets with durability and verification counted in.                                                    | `luwu-proof-at-write-stance` pays: scoping the recheck gives up whole-profile proof of later actions                                                                                                          |
| [`luwu-minimal-exposure-stance`](../luwu-minimal-exposure-stance/SKILL.md)             | exposure-vs-continuity                        | Sensitive values and external capability stay out of repositories, persistence, caches, logs and machine-readable output.                         | `luwu-continuable-evidence-stance` pays: metadata-only results hide which undeclared keys differ and in which direction                                                                                       |
| [`luwu-continuable-evidence-stance`](../luwu-continuable-evidence-stance/SKILL.md)     | exposure-vs-continuity, footprint-vs-recovery | A later person or agent can tell what happened, why, and what safe action continues.                                                              | `luwu-minimal-exposure-stance` pays: a durable record of undeclared values would expose sensitive content; `luwu-minimal-footprint-stance` pays: a journal or durable plan adds state Luwu must own and sweep |
| [`luwu-minimal-footprint-stance`](../luwu-minimal-footprint-stance/SKILL.md)           | footprint-vs-recovery                         | Act without damaging undeclared content, permissions or links, and without adding durable state of Luwu's own.                                    | `luwu-continuable-evidence-stance` pays: a fresh plan cannot resume or roll back an interrupted run                                                                                                           |
| [`luwu-answerable-authority-stance`](../luwu-answerable-authority-stance/SKILL.md)     | authority-vs-completion                       | Who may change a value stays declared and answerable; undeclared or conflicting content is never adopted by a default, force, or precedence rule. | `luwu-operational-completion-stance` pays: per-resource consent and conflict stops cost operator attention and migration time                                                                                 |
| [`luwu-operational-completion-stance`](../luwu-operational-completion-stance/SKILL.md) | authority-vs-completion                       | The routine loop finishes on a real profile without hand-edited files or deleted baselines, and the previous manager becomes removable.           | `luwu-answerable-authority-stance` pays: batch adoption and partial apply give up per-resource answerability                                                                                                  |
| [`luwu-proven-equivalence-stance`](../luwu-proven-equivalence-stance/SKILL.md)         | equivalence-vs-noise                          | Two representations are equal only on format or parser evidence, and unsupported syntax is preserved or refused.                                  | `luwu-quiet-signal-stance` pays: refusing unproven syntax leaves a real profile noisy or blocked                                                                                                              |
| [`luwu-quiet-signal-stance`](../luwu-quiet-signal-stance/SKILL.md)                     | equivalence-vs-noise                          | Only consequential differences reach the operator; incidental text, formatting, and converged state do not present themselves as drift.           | `luwu-proven-equivalence-stance` pays: normalizing incidental differences gives up proof that the bytes are equivalent                                                                                        |

## Oppositions

| Pair                                                                       | Contended resource                                               | Recorded sacrifice                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                | State   |
| -------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `luwu-proof-at-write-stance` vs `luwu-bounded-cost-stance`                 | latency and throughput of one apply over a whole profile         | Cost won twice: per-action expansion is scoped, and later actions no longer compare rendered desired bytes after the first directory creation. Proof won on mtime-only checks, parallel writers, and counting durability inside the budget.                                       | decided |
| `luwu-minimal-exposure-stance` vs `luwu-continuable-evidence-stance`       | user-visible surface and correctness of the operator's next step | Exposure won: no undeclared-value record, no secret digest, no provider cache. Evidence won where it costs no value: plan evidence, replacement flags, skip reason codes, and committed-but-baseline-not-advanced.                                                                | decided |
| `luwu-answerable-authority-stance` vs `luwu-operational-completion-stance` | operator attention and migration cost of moving a real profile   | Completion won inside one resource: apply writes a forward field while a sibling field needs review. Authority won on the generic rule: no force or precedence flag, no whole-file reverse copy, no automatic Dotter conversion.                                                  | decided |
| `luwu-minimal-footprint-stance` vs `luwu-continuable-evidence-stance`      | reversibility and durability of what a failed run leaves behind  | Footprint won: no transaction engine, journal, durable plan, replay, or rollback; a fresh plan is the recovery step. A SIGKILL between naming and renaming can leave a private temporary file that nothing sweeps.                                                                | decided |
| `luwu-proven-equivalence-stance` vs `luwu-quiet-signal-stance`             | correctness and the operator attention a false difference costs  | Equivalence won: no generic formatter or schema registry, a lexical TOML patcher with byte-level negative controls, re-render proof before an undeclared write. Quiet won where evidence exists: structured semantic equality and a baseline-only write for a converged template. | decided |
